pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 9.2.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to read fictional materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment
   In simple words: practise until you can read fictional texts for information and enjoyment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials.
4. Show that you can: read fictional texts for information and enjoyment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Identify fictional material to read by looking at the cover page, blurb, and title,
2. Read texts on varied issues such as national heroes and heroines and discuss the elements of fiction in the text,
3. List down words and phrases encountered,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to read fictional materials?
2. What should you consider when selecting fictional texts for reading?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
